Hours: Monday through Friday
Effective June 1, 2026:
County Offices are open 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Monday - Thursday; and 8:00 a.m. - 12:30 p.m. on Fridays
Some offices are available by appointment before and/or after hours - see individual department pages for operating hours and contact information.
On Fridays , the Treasurer’s Office is open by appointment only, no walk-ins.

Treasurer's Office - Skip The Line
Need to renew your registration? Transfer a license plate? Pay your property taxes?
Hate to wait? Skip the line and pay online , or schedule an appointment .
How to make your appointment:
Scan the QR code above, or use this online appointment link .
Select your appointment and choose an available date and time.
Review what you need to bring before coming to the office.
Arrive for your scheduled appointment at the Geary County Treasurer's Office! 200 E 8th St, Junction City KS 66441
BEFORE YOU BOOK:
Please review the Motor Vehicle and/or Property information on the Geary County website to make sure you have all required documents for your transaction(s). If you have questions about what you need, you may visit the County Treasurer's page here , or call the office at 785-238-6021.
Appointments help reduce waiting and make your visit more convenient.
Treasurer's Office Hours:
Monday - Thursday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. walk-ins and appointments
Friday appointment only: 8:00 a.m. - 12:30 p.m.
